notes: The carried task-001 candidate required no further code or test edits after inspection. RemoveCustomGroupMember is actor-bearing and Club-routed, while GroupMemberRemoved and the trusted RemoveGroupMember path remain actor-free. Focused assertions prove a real transition emits only GroupMemberRemoved, target and actor identities come from current aggregate state, member/self/final-member and outside-manager removal work, retries are event-free, outsiders/system groups are rejected, and club membership plus Admin role/club.manage_members authority remain intact. The custom group is unchanged because GroupMemberRemoved only deactivates its keyed group-membership entry; no club/role/invitation event is emitted. The earlier full-check timeout is superseded by this packet's focused-validation contract; the deterministic dev_check node owns the full gate.
